Compared origin.identifier literally with the publisher heading, and compared origin.source with history[0].origin.source. challenge.results: Shield’s heading names Shield 1.0.0 and its Noncompete text also refers to products the licensor or its affiliates provide using the software. Both observations reject the reversed mapping. Substituting the Perimeter heading for the catalog key fails literal comparison. The history locator omits .txt despite retaining the same name, demonstrating that the name alone cannot identify the artifact. Appending #altered changed the computed origin digest. None of these adverse cases contradicts the exact current mapping.
